query_1.query: Build a concise structural triage card for rucaparib targeting PARP1. ONE card, four blocks: (Chemistry) rucaparib's canonical SMILES; (Target) PARP1 amino-acid sequence length and mean pLDDT; (Structures) the top 3 experimental PDB structures ranked best-resolution-first with PDB id, resolution, method; (Binding) the measured affinity from the knowledge graph plus the M2 predicted_score and predicted_label from predict_binding in pairs mode for (rucaparib, PARP1). Single card; end with the one-line M2 class-imbalance disclaimer. No extra sections.
query_1.title_card: Profiling Rucaparib–PARP1 Binding in Synthetic-Lethality Oncology

query_2.query: For the apoptosis gene CASP3, build a concise functional readout; keep each part to its top result and mark anything absent as a 'data gap'. query_2.title_card: Profiling CASP3 Apoptosis Biology with Literature and Chemical Evidence
